item.title: Pinterest GIF Downloader
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
How to Download a Pinterest GIF

Saving a Pinterest GIF works the same way as saving a link, just three steps.

  1. Open Pinterest and find the GIF you want.
  2. Tap the share icon and choose “Copy Link.”
  3. Paste the link above and tap Download.

The file saves as a real GIF, so it keeps moving wherever you open it.

How to Download a Pinterest GIF on PC

The steps are the same on a computer as on your phone, just done inside a browser instead of the app.

  1. Open Pinterest.com in your browser and find the GIF.
  2. Click the pin, then copy the link from your address bar.
  3. Paste the link above and click Download.
  4. The GIF saves to your computer’s Downloads folder, animation intact.

Why Downloaded GIFs Sometimes Stop Moving

A lot of tools convert a Pinterest GIF into a video file, or re-encode it, which can drop frames or turn it into a silent clip that doesn’t loop right. PinsDownload doesn’t touch the file. It pulls the original GIF Pinterest is already serving, so the animation and loop stay exactly as the creator made them.

Why This GIF Downloader Is Different

Most Pinterest GIF tools quietly convert your file to MP4 because it’s easier for them to process. That’s not a GIF anymore, and it won’t work the same way in a text message or a slideshow. PinsDownload keeps the file in its native GIF format every time. A small number of ads keep the tool free, and they stay well clear of the Download button.

What Else You Can Download From Pinterest

GIFs are just one part of what PinsDownload handles.

  • Videos — save Pinterest videos in HD, up to 4K when the source has it.
  • Images and photos — save any pin in full resolution.
  • Reels and short videos — grab Pinterest’s short-form clips.
  • Stories and Idea Pins — save every slide of a multi-page pin.
  • Carousels — download every image or video in a multi-item pin.
  • Boards — save an entire board of GIFs and images at once, or download it as a ZIP file.
  • Profiles — download every public pin from a Pinterest profile.

What Is a Pinterest GIF Downloader?

A Pinterest GIF downloader is a free tool that saves an animated Pinterest pin as an actual GIF file on your device. Pinterest’s app and website only let you re-pin or share a GIF, not download it directly, so a tool like this reads the pin’s link and gives you the real animated file. No account is needed, and nothing is stored after your download finishes.

What People Use Pinterest GIFs For

Reaction GIFs for messaging · Meme templates · Short animated tutorials · Product demo loops · Fitness move demonstrations · Recipe step animations · Craft and DIY process clips

item.title: Pinterest Image Downloader
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
How to Download a Pinterest Image

Saving a Pinterest image takes three steps, and none of them need an app.

  1. Open Pinterest and find the image you want.
  2. Tap the share icon and choose “Copy Link.”
  3. Paste the link above and tap Download.

The photo saves at full size, exactly as the pin creator uploaded it.

Why Pinterest Doesn’t Let You Save Images Directly

Pinterest’s own save button only pins an image to your board inside Pinterest. It doesn’t give you a file on your device. That’s the gap this page fills. PinsDownload reads the pin’s link, finds the actual image file behind it, and hands you a direct download instead of another pin on another board.

Why This Image Downloader Is Different

Most Pinterest downloaders compress the image on the way out, or crop it to fit a preview box. PinsDownload doesn’t touch the file. What you download is the same file Pinterest itself is serving, pixel for pixel. A small number of ads keep the tool free, but they’re kept away from the Download button so you never tap the wrong thing by mistake.

What Else You Can Download From Pinterest

Photos are only one piece of what’s on Pinterest. PinsDownload covers the rest too.

  • Videos — save Pinterest videos in HD, up to 4K when the source has it.
  • GIFs — download animated pins without losing the loop.
  • Reels and short videos — grab Pinterest’s short-form clips.
  • Stories and Idea Pins — save every slide of a multi-page pin.
  • Carousels — download every image or video in a multi-item pin.
  • Boards — save an entire board of images at once, or download it as a ZIP file.
  • Profiles — download every public image from a Pinterest profile.

What Is a Pinterest Image Downloader?

A Pinterest image downloader is a free tool that saves a Pinterest photo to your device as an actual file, instead of just pinning it to another board. Pinterest’s website and app only let you re-pin or share an image, not download it directly, so a tool like this reads the pin’s link and gives you the real file. No account is needed, and the image isn’t stored anywhere after your download finishes.

What People Save Images For

Home décor and interior design boards · Recipe cards and food photography · Outfit and style references · Craft and DIY project photos · Wedding mood boards · Travel photo inspiration · Study notes and infographics · Art and design references

item.title: About Us
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
PinsDownload is a free tool that saves Pinterest videos, images, GIFs, and boards to your device. Pinterest lets you pin content to your own boards, but it doesn’t give you a direct way to save a file. PinsDownload fills that gap.

We built this tool around three rules. No login, ever. No watermark added to your download. No storing of the files you download once they’ve been sent to you.

PinsDownload is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to Pinterest in any way. Pinterest is a trademark of Pinterest, Inc. We simply built a tool that works with public Pinterest links.

A small number of ads keep this tool free to use. We keep them clearly separated from the Download button, so you always know what you’re clicking.

If something isn’t working, or you have a question, our Contact page is the fastest way to reach us.

item.title: Privacy Policy
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Last updated: August 17, 2026

This page explains what information PinsDownload collects when you use the site, and what we do with it.

What we don’t collect
We never ask for your Pinterest username or password. We don’t require an account to use this tool. We don’t store the videos, images, or GIFs you download once they’ve been delivered to your device.

What we do collect
Like most websites, we use standard analytics to see which pages are used and how the site performs. This includes things like page views, browser type, and approximate location based on IP address. We do not connect this data to any personal identity.

Cookies and ads
This site uses cookies for basic site function and, since PinsDownload runs on a small number of ads to stay free, for ad delivery through third-party ad networks. These networks may use cookies to show relevant ads. You can control or delete cookies through your browser settings at any time.

Third-party links
Trust badge links on this site (Google Safe Browsing, Norton Safe Web, Sucuri Scanner) send you to third-party websites. Their own privacy policies apply once you leave PinsDownload.

Children’s privacy
This site is not directed at children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect information from children.

Your rights
You can contact us at privacy@pinsdownload.org to ask what data we hold about your visits or to request it be deleted, where applicable under your local law.

Changes to this policy
We may update this page as the site changes. The date at the top will always show the most recent update.

item.title: DMCA Policy
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded:
Last updated: August 17, 2026

PinsDownload respects copyright and responds to valid takedown requests under the Digital Millennium Copyright Act (DMCA).

What this policy covers
PinsDownload does not host Pinterest content. It reads a public Pinterest link and delivers a copy of the file Pinterest is already serving. If you believe your copyrighted work has been made available through a Pinterest link and you’d like it addressed, contact us using the process below.

How to submit a takedown request
Send a written notice to our designated agent (contact details below) that includes:

  1. Your name, address, and a way to reach you.
  2. A description of the copyrighted work you believe was infringed.
  3. The specific Pinterest link or URL where the content appears.
  4. A statement that you have a good faith belief the use is not authorized by the copyright owner, its agent, or the law.
  5. A statement, made under penalty of perjury, that the information in your notice is accurate and that you are the copyright owner or authorized to act on their behalf.
  6. Your physical or electronic signature.

Designated agent for copyright notices
[Name / Company]
Email: [dmca@pinsdownload.org]
Address: [physical address, required for a valid DMCA agent registration]

Counter-notice
If you believe content was removed or restricted by mistake, you can submit a counter-notice with your contact information, identification of the content, and a statement under penalty of perjury that you believe the removal was a mistake.

Repeat infringers
We reserve the right to restrict access for users or links repeatedly linked to valid copyright complaints.
